tools.name: DaVinci Resolve
steps: Download the free version from the official site and install it.
Open DaVinci Resolve, create a new project, and import clips into the Media Pool.
Drag clips to the timeline on the Edit page; trim, add transitions and titles.
Use the Color page for AI-powered color matching and correction.
Deliver (export) your video as MP4.

tools.name: CapCut
steps: Install CapCut (desktop or mobile) or open the web editor.
Import your video and drag it onto the timeline.
Use Auto Cut for AI highlight assembly, or Auto Captions on the Text tab.
Apply free effects, transitions, and music.
Export and download your video.

tools.name: Clipchamp
steps: Open clipchamp.com or the Clipchamp app and sign in with a Microsoft account.
Create a video and import your media.
Use AI features such as auto compose, text-to-speech, and speaker coach.
Edit on the timeline and add filters and transitions.
Export in 1080p (free tier) and download.

tools.name: Canva
steps: Go to canva.com, search "video", and pick a template or start blank.
Upload clips or use Canva's free stock video library.
Use Magic Edit and AI tools to adjust clips; add text, animation, and music.
Download as MP4 (some premium assets require Pro).

tools.name: OpusClip
tools.cost: Free tier (paid plans for more credits)
steps: Go to opusclip.com and paste a video URL or upload a file.
Choose a caption style and preferred clip length.
Let AI generate short captioned clips from the long video.
Review the transcript-based timeline, edit, and download.

tools.name: Whisper
steps: Install Python if you don't have it.
Run: pip install openai-whisper (ffmpeg must also be installed).
Run: whisper your-video.mp4 --model base
Whisper writes subtitle files (SRT, VTT, TXT) into the current folder.

tools.name: VEED.io
steps: Go to veed.io and upload your video to the editor.
Open the Subtitles tab and choose Auto Subtitles.
Edit caption text and timing, then set fonts and colors.
Export and download (free tier includes a watermark).

tools.name: Kapwing
steps: Go to kapwing.com and start a new project with your video.
Open Subtitles and choose Auto-generate.
Review the AI transcript, fix errors, and set the style.
Export and download (free tier is watermarked).

tools.name: Submagic
steps: Go to submagic.co and upload your video.
Select the language and a caption template.
AI generates dynamic captions with emojis and highlighted keywords.
Download the captioned video (free tier limits monthly exports).

tools.name: Adobe Express
steps: Go to adobe.com/express and open the thumbnail maker.
Pick a YouTube thumbnail template or start from scratch.
Upload a video frame or image; add AI text effects and graphics.
Download as PNG or JPG.

tools.name: Canva
steps: Go to canva.com and search "YouTube thumbnail"; pick a template.
Upload your image and use AI thumbnail tools.
Add text, stickers, and effects.
Download your thumbnail.

tools.name: Fotor
steps: Go to fotor.com and open the YouTube thumbnail creator.
Choose a template and upload your image.
Use AI enhancement tools; add text, stickers, and effects.
Download your thumbnail.

tools.name: Simplified
steps: Go to simplified.com and open the AI thumbnail generator.
Describe your video topic and choose a style.
Generate thumbnail options and edit text, colors, and images.
Download the design.

tools.name: Media.io
steps: Go to media.io and open the online video enhancer.
Upload your video and choose enhancement options.
Process the video in your browser.
Download the enhanced result (free tier is watermarked).

tools.name: CapCut
steps: Open CapCut and import your video.
Apply the AI video upscaler/enhancer to your clip.
Adjust brightness, contrast, and color as needed.
Export and download the enhanced video.

tools.name: VEED.io
steps: Go to veed.io and upload your video.
Open the video enhancer and adjust resolution, color, and noise.
Preview the enhanced result.
Export and download (free tier includes a watermark).
